kind.content: Mara Ellison photographs people, coastlines and cities at the edges of the day. Editorial, portrait and commissioned work from a small studio in Norwick.
I don’t chase the picture. I wait for the light to arrive, and for people to forget I’m there. The result is work that feels less taken than found.
